geometry.capture: focused row segment x=747..1080 inclusive; capture in 16-pixel chunks and combine only after exact-size checks

rowdriver.binding: all scheduled rowdriver ranges complete before normalization

pre_normalization.identity: first instruction of internal normalization loop

binding.runner: run_alpha_fade_row755.ps1 exactly as supplied; AE must be closed first; JSX launches from a fixed no-space Public path; pause-after-effect-add, hash-pinned live module lookup, absolute-base CDB attach, and nested capture_at_5554.cdb execution are mandatory
binding.run_id: must be identical in every trace record and return JSON
binding.params: same refcon pointer at worker, rowdriver, and normalization records
binding.row: normalization tile must contain global row 755 and global x 747..1080; typed addresses subtract row0/col0 from global coordinates
binding.stage: normalization offset must be exactly 0x5554; no post-normalization capture accepted
binding.address_provenance: all three plane bases and row/column/stride fields must be emitted from the same params pointer
binding.chunk_capture: 21 chunks per plane, 16 pixels per chunk except the final 14-pixel chunk; partial chunks are rejected

runtime_actions.action: run the supplied case once under the exact AEX and stop at the first pre-normalization hook after the real worker schedule
